name: cm.cv/cv-cm
title: cv.cm
description: Search cv.cm's free browser tools, personality tests and tutorials; read its rankings and datasets.

tools.name: search_cv_cm
tools.description: Search every page on cv.cm: free browser tools, personality tests, rankings, datasets, tutorials, memes, pose reference, country, food, emoji and breed pages. Returns titles, one-line descriptions and page URLs. Send the user to the url to use a tool or take a test; cite the url when you quote a page.

query.description: What the user wants, e.g. 'remove background', 'leadership style test', 'tallest mountains'.

language.description: Page language: en, zh-cn, zh-tw, ja, ko, vi, id, es, pt-br. Default en. Answer in the user's language.

channel.description: Only this section: tool (free browser tools (image, PDF, audio, text, calculators, AI that runs on the device)); learn (illustrated how-to tutorials); kb (sourced explainers: coding, AI, photography, self-massage, relationships); tests (personality tests and quizzes); datasets (public reference tables with CSV); rankings (sourced rankings with CSV); reference (pose, hairstyle, expression and outfit reference for artists and photographers); slang (memes and internet slang); ideas (business ideas with a demand outlook); nostalgia (things from 1980s–2000s childhoods); manuals (help for lost product manuals); folklore (legends, creatures and folktales from around the world, with sources); calories (food calories and nutrition); calendar (calendars, public holidays, lunar dates); countries (country profiles); elements (periodic table); emoji (emoji meanings); currency (exchange rates); marketHistory (gold, silver, oil, copper, dollar and Treasury yield history through Fed rate cycles, recessions, elections and crises, with sources); breeds (dog and cat breeds).

tools.name: list_cv_cm_pages
tools.description: List the pages of one cv.cm section (for example every personality test or every ranking), with titles, descriptions and URLs, page by page.

tools.name: get_cv_cm_ranking
tools.description: Rows of a sourced ranking on cv.cm (AI models, browser and phone market share, commodities, currencies, mountains, rivers, lakes, islands, deserts, buildings, cities, stadiums), with its source, licence, update date and page URL. ids: ai-models, ai-coding-models, ai-image-models, ai-video-models, ai-usage, ai-companies, browser-market-share, os-market-share, search-engine-market-share, phone-market-share, social-media-market-share, crypto-market-cap, commodity-prices, currency-strength, tallest-mountains, longest-rivers, largest-lakes, largest-islands, largest-deserts, tallest-buildings, largest-cities, largest-stadiums. crypto-market-cap returns only the page link: its source does not allow redistributing the rows.

language.description: Page language: en, zh-cn, zh-tw, ja, ko, vi, id, es, pt-br. Default en. Answer in the user's language.
